- 2 cups flour
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/4 cup butter, cold & cubed
- 1 cup cheddar cheese, grated
- 3/4 cup milk

Steps:
1. Heat oven to 425°F (220°C). Mix flour, baking powder, and salt. Cut in butter until it looks like crumbs.
2. Add cheese. Pour in milk and mix to a soft dough.
3. Flatten dough on a surface to 1 inch thick; cut into wedges.
